name: rbi_get_exchange_rate
description:
Indian rupee reference exchange rates (INR per foreign currency) against the US dollar, euro, pound sterling or Japanese yen, from the Reserve Bank of India's DBIE endpoint (rbi.org.in/Scripts/api/dbie, no API key).
Returns: series_code, label, description, unit, frequency, observation_count and observations (date, value) as the endpoint orders them.
Inputs (* required): currency_pair* (usd_inr, eur_inr, gbp_inr, jpy_inr; schema default usd_inr); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, passed through as fromDate and toDate); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; keeps the last N observations, only when no date is given).
For India's reserves use rbi_get_forex_reserves; for other currency bases ecb_get_exchange_rate or boc_get_exchange_rate.
Example: {"currency_pair": "usd_inr", "recent_periods": 30}
